claude_proposed_widenings.name: change_size
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait's primary effect is a temporary creature-size change to Large. The current surface has speed and roll riders, but no effect atom for changing creature size.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: availableAtCharacterLevel for SpeciesTraitRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is locked until character level 5. Species traits currently have no level-unlock field or equivalent activation guard, so authoring it now would falsely imply availability at level 1.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: voluntary_end on activated-ability duration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The transformation can be ended early by the bearer without spending an action. Current Duration shapes model timed expiry and several early-end triggers, but not owner-initiated dismissal for activated species traits.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required).
